body:
# Water Pump

Tired of draining huge water reservoirs block by block?

Water Pump is a simple utility mod that lets you quickly remove large volumes of water from lakes, reservoirs, underground chambers, and even the ocean floor.

## Features

* Place the pump directly into a wall.
* Automatically drains connected water blocks.
* Removes water down to the pump’s installation level.
* Works with natural and player-made reservoirs.
* Simple and survival-friendly design.

## How It Works

Install the pump in the wall of a water-filled area and activate it.

The pump will gradually remove all connected water sources until the water level reaches the base of the pump.

The extracted water is discharged through the pump outlet. If you don’t want water flowing from the outlet, simply place a solid block in front of it.

### Ocean Engineering

The real fun begins when you start experimenting with the pump on the ocean floor.

Create underwater construction sites, drain sections of the seabed, build hidden bases, or reshape entire underwater landscapes with minimal effort.

## Perfect For

* Underwater bases
* Large construction projects
* Draining caves and mines
* Harbor and canal construction
* Survival world infrastructure
* Technical and engineering builds

No more endless sponge placement.

No more fighting infinite water sources.

Just place the pump and let it do the work.
